verdicts.evidence: repro/A6b-verify/signout.test.ts (run: cd apps/frontend && npx vitest run --root ../../docs/review-2026-10-31/repro/A6b-verify -> 2 passed). Test 1: Sidebar.tsx:151 is onClick={logout}; auth.tsx:142-148 logout() awaits POST /api/auth/logout then clearLocalAuthState, with no confirmDiscard/hasUnsavedChanges anywhere in auth.tsx, while a registered holder makes hasUnsavedChanges() true. Test 2: createSaveQueue tick, sign-out at 100 ms into the 400 ms debounce, session revoked, unmount sendPending() (useLineSaveQueue.ts:159 effect cleanup, after App.tsx:66 shellKey remount) -> the write goes out, fails 401, and onWriteError is never called (sendPending uses .catch(() => {})).
verdicts.reason: Reproduced on the desktop path: the sidebar sign-out icon is visible beside open editors and bypasses unsavedGuard, which every other discard path (Cancel, Escape, layout switch, route change) honours; the remount after setUser(null) fires sendPending only after the server revoked the session, and its failure is swallowed. Downgraded to P3: it needs a deliberate sign-out click, the Review-mode loss window is under 400 ms, and nothing on the server is corrupted (only unsaved local edits are lost). The Profile.tsx:151 location is mostly unreachable with dirty state: on phone, Profile is its own route, so reaching it already passes the route leave guard and unmounting Review sends pending ticks under a live session.
